    """
    geo_ids = pd.Index(sorted(set(int(g) for g in geo_ids)))
    years = np.arange(first_year, last_year + 1)
    shape = (len(geo_ids), len(years))
    row_of = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(geo_ids)}
    arrays: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}

    def add(name: str, i: int, bounds, amount: float = 1.0) -> None:
        if bounds is None:
            return
        a, b = max(bounds[0], first_year) - first_year, min(bounds[1], last_year) - first_year
        if a <= b:
            arrays.setdefault(name, np.zeros(shape))[i, a:b + 1] += amount

    ev = evidence[evidence["geo_id"].isin(geo_ids)]
    titles: dict[tuple[int, int], set] = {}
    attendance = np.full(shape, np.nan)
    decade = np.zeros(shape, dtype=bool)
    companies_seen: dict[tuple[int, str], tuple] = {}
    for r in ev.itertuples(index=False):
        i = row_of[int(r.geo_id)]
        certain, possible = year_bounds(r.start_lo, r.start_hi, r.end_lo, r.end_hi,
                                        bool(r.open_end), bool(r.hedged), last_year)
        prefix = "puppet_" if r.puppet else ""
        if r.pause and certain is not None:
            add("pause", i, certain)
        if r.czech_activity and not r.puppet:
            add("any_activity_certain", i, certain)
            add("any_activity_possible", i, possible)
            if possible is not None and possible[0] // 10 == possible[1] // 10:
                d0 = possible[0] // 10 * 10
                add("_decade", i, (d0, d0 + 9))
        if r.puppet and (r.czech_activity or r.company):
            add("puppet_activity_certain", i, certain)
            add("puppet_activity_possible", i, possible)
        if r.company and isinstance(r.company_id, str) and not r.puppet:
            seen = companies_seen.setdefault((i, r.company_id), [None, []])
            seen[0] = _hull(seen[0], certain)
            if possible is not None:
                seen[1].append(possible)
        if r.performance and r.czech_activity:
            single = certain is not None and certain[0] == certain[1]
            stated = not pd.isna(r.count_stated)
            if single:
                add(f"{prefix}performances_min_certain", i, certain, r.count_stated if stated else 1.0)
            elif certain is not None and stated and not r.puppet:
                # `1883-1910 173 her`: an average over the span, not a minimum in any year
                add("performances_period_avg", i, certain, r.count_stated / (certain[1] - certain[0] + 1))
            add(f"{prefix}performances_min_possible", i, possible)
            if single and r.titles and not r.puppet:
                titles.setdefault((i, certain[0]), set()).update(r.titles.split("|"))
        for column in EVENT_COLUMNS:
            if column != "performance" and getattr(r, column):
                add(f"{column}_certain", i, certain)
                add(f"{column}_possible", i, possible)
        if not pd.isna(r.attendance_n) and certain is not None and certain[0] == certain[1]:
            j = certain[0] - first_year
            if 0 <= j < len(years):
                attendance[i, j] = np.nanmax([attendance[i, j], r.attendance_n])
    for (i, _), (certain, possibles) in companies_seen.items():
        add("ensembles_active_certain", i, certain)
        covered = np.zeros(len(years), dtype=bool)
        for bounds in ([certain] if certain else []) + possibles:
            a, b = max(bounds[0], first_year) - first_year, min(bounds[1], last_year) - first_year
            if a <= b:
                covered[a:b + 1] = True
        arrays.setdefault("ensembles_active_possible", np.zeros(shape))[i] += covered
    for (i, year), found in titles.items():
        if first_year <= year <= last_year:
            arrays.setdefault("plays_distinct_certain", np.zeros(shape))[i, year - first_year] = len(found)
    decade = arrays.pop("_decade", np.zeros(shape)) > 0
    return _panel_frame(arrays, attendance, decade, geo_ids, years)


def _hull(a, b):
    """Two certain ranges of one company as one: from the earliest certain start to the
    latest certain end, since the company existed in between.  Its *possible* years are
    the union of its records' ranges and the certain hull, not their hull (D-145): a gap
    between two listed decades is not evidence."""
    if a is None or b is None:
        return a if b is None else b
    return min(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1])


PANEL_COUNT_COLUMNS = (
    [f"{base}_{bound}" for base in ("any_activity", "ensembles_active", "performances_min")
     for bound in ("certain", "possible")]
    + ["plays_distinct_certain"]
    + [f"{c}_{bound}" for c in EVENT_COLUMNS if c != "performance" for bound in ("certain", "possible")]
    + [f"puppet_{base}_{bound}" for base in ("activity", "performances_min") for bound in ("certain", "possible")])


def _panel_frame(arrays: dict, attendance: np.ndarray, decade: np.ndarray, geo_ids, years) -> pd.DataFrame:
    shape = (len(geo_ids), len(years))
    pause = arrays.pop("pause", np.zeros(shape)) > 0
    for name in ("any_activity_certain", "ensembles_active_certain"):
        if name in arrays:                   # B12: a recorded pause makes certain only possible
            arrays[name][pause] = 0
    out = pd.DataFrame({"geo_id": np.repeat(geo_ids.to_numpy(), len(years)),
                        "year": np.tile(years, len(geo_ids))})
    for name in PANEL_COUNT_COLUMNS:
        values = arrays.get(name, np.zeros(shape)).ravel()
        if name.startswith(("any_activity", "puppet_activity")):
            out[name] = values > 0
        else:
            out[name] = values.astype("int32")
    out["performances_period_avg"] = arrays.get("performances_period_avg", np.zeros(shape)).ravel().round(2)
    out["attendance_max"] = attendance.ravel()
    out["activity_decade_certain"] = decade.ravel() | out["any_activity_certain"].to_numpy()
    out["activity_decade_certain"] = out.groupby(["geo_id", out["year"] // 10])[
        "activity_decade_certain"].transform("any")
    out["pause_recorded"] = pause.ravel()
    assert not out.duplicated(PANEL_KEY).any(), "panel: key not unique"
    assert (out["any_activity_possible"] | ~out["any_activity_certain"]).all(), "panel: certain ⊄ possible"
    return out


AREA_LEVELS = {"settlement": "settlement_row", "court": "court_id", "okres": "okres_id"}


def area_year_tables(panel: pd.DataFrame, join: pd.DataFrame,
                     settlements: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """The place panel summed to 1910 settlement, court and okres × year.

    ``join`` is :func:`join_places_to_settlements` (one row per place, a settlement used
    at most once); ``settlements`` is :func:`settlement_frame`.  Every 1910 settlement,
    court and okres of the frame gets every year, so a unit with no database place is a
    row of zeros (D-141: the treatment's zero, memory of the German areas).  Counts are
    summed; ``any_activity_*`` becomes ``places_active_*`` (settlements with activity) and
    ``any_activity_*`` (any); ``attendance_max`` the maximum.  ``places_in_database`` is
    the number of database places tied to the unit.  Keys asserted:
    ``(settlement_row | court_id | okres_id, year)``.  Places tied to no settlement are
    not in these tables (``join``'s ``match_method`` says why).
    """
    tied = join.dropna(subset=["settlement_row"]).astype({"settlement_row": "int64"})
    S = settlements[settlements["in_1910"]][["settlement_row", "court_id", "okres_id"]]
    units = tied.merge(S, on="settlement_row", how="inner", validate="1:1")
    n_before = len(panel)
    P = panel.merge(units[["geo_id", "settlement_row", "court_id", "okres_id"]], on="geo_id",
                    how="inner", validate="m:1")
    assert len(P) <= n_before
    bools = [c for c in panel.columns if panel[c].dtype == bool]
    counts = [c for c in panel.columns if c not in bools + PANEL_KEY + ["attendance_max"]]
    years = np.sort(panel["year"].unique())
    tables = {}
    for level, key in AREA_LEVELS.items():
        agg = P.groupby([key, "year"]).agg(
            **{c: (c, "sum") for c in counts},
            **{c: (c, "any") for c in bools},
            **{c.replace("any_activity", "places_active"): (c, "sum")
               for c in ("any_activity_certain", "any_activity_possible")},
            attendance_max=("attendance_max", "max"))
        ids = S[key].dropna().unique()
        grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([np.sort(ids), years], names=[key, "year"])
        out = agg.reindex(grid).reset_index()
        filled = [c for c in out.columns if c not in (key, "year", "attendance_max")]
        for c in filled:
            out[c] = (out[c].astype("boolean").fillna(False).astype(bool) if c in bools
                      else out[c].fillna(0).astype(agg[c].dtype))
        per_unit = units.groupby(key).size().rename("places_in_database")
        out = out.merge(per_unit, left_on=key, right_index=True, how="left", validate="m:1")
        out["places_in_database"] = out["places_in_database"].fillna(0).astype(int)
        assert not out.duplicated([key, "year"]).any(), f"{level} panel: key not unique"
        tables[level] = out
    return tables


def panel_report(panel: pd.DataFrame, evidence: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    """Print what the panel holds: evidence by source, places and place-years active."""
    print("\n── evidence by source\n" + evidence.groupby("source").agg(
        rows=("evidence_id", "size"), czech_activity=("czech_activity", "sum"),
        companies=("company_id", "nunique")).to_string())
    active = panel.groupby("geo_id")[["any_activity_certain", "any_activity_possible"]].any()
    print(f"\nplaces with Czech activity {PANEL_FIRST_YEAR}–{PANEL_LAST_YEAR}: certain "
          f"{int(active['any_activity_certain'].sum()):,}, possible {int(active['any_activity_possible'].sum()):,}"
          f" of {panel['geo_id'].nunique():,}")
    by_decade = panel.assign(decade=panel["year"] // 10 * 10).groupby("decade")[
        ["any_activity_certain", "any_activity_possible", "ensembles_active_certain",
         "performances_min_certain", "german_certain"]].sum()
    print("\n── place-years by decade (sums over place-years)\n" + by_decade.to_string())


def ensemble_page_summary(pages: pd.DataFrame, ensembles: pd.DataFrame,
                          cutoff: int = PRE_WAR_CUTOFF) -> dict[str, int]:
    """What the ensemble pages add to the list's start (D-145), one count per ensemble.

    ``end_year``: the page prints an end or last report as a year or decade.
    ``decades``: it lists a decade.  ``decade_after_start``: a listed decade after the
    start's decade and before ``cutoff``.  ``closes_before_cutoff``: its last listed decade
    ends before ``cutoff`` (the open end it replaces ran to the cutoff).
    ``decade_before_start``: it lists a decade before the start's (kept as printed).
    ``chronicle_after_start``: its own chronicle has a dated line after the start and
    before ``cutoff``.  ``uninformative``: none of the end, a later decade or a later line.
    """
    start = ensembles.groupby("ensemble_id")["year_from"].min()
    P = pages.set_index("ensemble_id")
    P = P.assign(start=start.reindex(P.index))
    decades = P["active_decades"].map(active_decade_list)
    start_decade = P["start"] // 10 * 10
    later = [any(s < d < cutoff for d in ds) for ds, s in zip(decades, start_decade)]
    before = [any(d < s for d in ds) for ds, s in zip(decades, start_decade)]
    closes = [bool(ds) and max(ds) + 9 < cutoff - 1 for ds in decades]
    line_year = re.compile(rf"^\s*{_DAY_MONTH}(1[5-9]\d\d)\b")
    chron = [isinstance(t, str) and any(s < int(m.group(1)) < cutoff for m in map(line_year.match, t.splitlines()) if m)
             for t, s in zip(P["chronicle_text"], P["start"])]
    end = P["ended_precision"].isin(["year", "decade"]).to_numpy()
    informative = end | np.array(later) | np.array(chron)
    return {"pages": len(P), "end_year": int(end.sum()), "decades": int(decades.map(bool).sum()),
            "decade_after_start": int(sum(later)), "closes_before_cutoff": int(sum(closes)),
            "decade_before_start": int(sum(before)), "chronicle_after_start": int(sum(chron)),
            "uninformative": int((~informative).sum())}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tabulation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _share_table(frame: pd.DataFrame, by: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    table = frame.groupby(by, dropna=False).agg(
        settlements=("settlement_row", "size"),
        in_database=("geo_id", lambda s: int(s.notna().sum())),
        ensemble_pre1914=("ensemble_pre", "sum"),
        ambiguous_191x=("ensemble_ambiguous", "sum"),
        first_record_pre1914=("first_record_pre", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    for col in ("in_database", "ensemble_pre1914", "first_record_pre1914"):
        table[f"share_{col}"] = (table[col] / table["settlements"]).round(3)
    return table


def _documentation_table(paged: pd.DataFrame, by: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """How much the database records per place, grouped by ``by``."""
    return paged.groupby(by, dropna=False).agg(
        places=("geo_id", "size"),
        with_first_record=("first_record_known", "mean"),
        first_record_pre1914=("first_record_pre", "mean"),
        with_any_ensemble=("n_ensembles", lambda s: (s > 0).mean()),
        ensembles_per_place=("n_ensembles", "mean"),
        with_ensemble_pre1914=("ensemble_pre", "mean"),
        with_archive_citation=("archive_chars", lambda s: (s > 0).mean()),
        with_bibliography=("bibliography_chars", lambda s: (s > 0).mean()),
        median_chronicle_chars=("text_chars", "median"),
    ).round(3).reset_index()


def coverage_tables(
    places: pd.DataFrame,
    ensembles: pd.DataFrame,
    settlements: pd.DataFrame,
    districts: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    *,
    okresy: list[str] | None,
    census: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    cutoff: int = PRE_WAR_CUTOFF,
) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Every table of the pilot, for the scraped sample and (from step A) the country.

    Args:
        places: scraper ``places.csv`` (all places; page fields filled for the sample).
        ensembles: scraper ``ensembles.csv``.
        settlements: ``data/final/geo/settlements_1910``.
        districts: ``data/final/geo/districts_1910`` (district names + court seats).
        okresy: the present-day okresy that were scraped; ``None`` once all of them are,
            in which case the denominator is every 1910 settlement rather than those whose
            okres timeline ends in a sample okres.
        census: ``census_okres_1910`` — if given, each 1910 okres gets its Czech-speaking
            share, the first thing coverage of a *Czech* theatre database depends on.

    Returns:
        A dict of DataFrames; :func:`coverage_report` prints them.
    """
    S = settlement_frame(settlements, districts)
    whole_country = okresy is None
    okresy = sorted(places["okres"].dropna().unique()) if whole_country else list(okresy)
    sample = places.copy() if whole_country else places[places["okres"].isin(okresy)].copy()
    missing_pages = int((~sample["page_cached"]).sum())
    tables: dict[str, pd.DataFrame] = {}

    # ── the join, on the sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    join = join_places_to_settlements(sample, S)
    n_before = len(sample)
    sample = sample.merge(join, on="geo_id", how="left", validate="1:1")
    assert len(sample) == n_before, "place ↔ join merge changed the row count"
    dates = place_dates(sample, ensembles[ensembles["geo_id"].isin(sample["geo_id"])], cutoff)
    sample = sample.merge(dates, on="geo_id", how="left", validate="1:1")
    assert len(sample) == n_before
    sample["matched"] = sample["settlement_row"].notna()
    # a place's crown land is that of the 1910 settlement it ties to
    sample = sample.merge(S[["settlement_row", "land"]].astype({"settlement_row": "Int64"}),
                          on="settlement_row", how="left", validate="m:1")
    assert len(sample) == n_before

    tables["join_by_method"] = (sample.groupby(["type", "match_method"]).size()
                                .unstack("type", fill_value=0).assign(all=lambda t: t.sum(axis=1)))
    tables["join_rate"] = sample.groupby("okres").agg(
        places=("geo_id", "size"), matched=("matched", "sum"),
        match_rate=("matched", "mean")).round(3).reset_index()
    tables["unmatched_places"] = sample.loc[~sample["matched"],
                                            ["geo_id", "name", "type", "okres", "match_method",
                                             "n_ensembles", "first_record_year"]]

    # ── the 1910 settlements of the sample area ─────────────────────────────
    in_scope = S["in_1910"] if whole_country else S["in_1910"] & S["okres_now"].isin(okresy)
    scope = S[in_scope]
    n_scope = len(scope)
    tied = sample.loc[sample["matched"], ["settlement_row", "geo_id", "ensemble_pre",
                                          "ensemble_ambiguous", "first_record_pre",
                                          "n_ensembles"]].astype({"settlement_row": "int64"})
    outside_scope = int((~tied["settlement_row"].isin(scope["settlement_row"])).sum())
    cover = scope.merge(tied, on="settlement_row", how="left", validate="1:1")
    assert len(cover) == n_scope, "settlement ↔ place merge changed the row count"
    for col in ("ensemble_pre", "ensemble_ambiguous", "first_record_pre"):
        cover[col] = cover[col].eq(True)          # no database place → not recorded
    by_okres = _share_table(cover, ["okres_now", "land", "okres_id", "okres_1910_cs"])
    if census is not None:
        by_okres = by_okres.merge(census[["okres_id", "lang_czech_share"]], on="okres_id",
                                  how="left", validate="m:1")
        by_okres["lang_czech_share"] = by_okres["lang_czech_share"].round(3)
    tables["settlements_by_okres_1910"] = by_okres
    tables["settlements_by_land"] = _share_table(cover, ["land"])
    tables["settlements_by_size"] = _share_table(cover, ["size_class"])
    tables["settlements_by_land_and_size"] = _share_table(cover, ["land", "size_class"])
    if census is not None:
        # a database of *Czech* theatre: coverage has to be read within language bands
        banded = cover.merge(census[["okres_id", "lang_czech_share"]], on="okres_id",
                             how="left", validate="m:1")
        assert len(banded) == n_scope, "settlement ↔ census merge changed the row count"
        banded["okres_language"] = pd.cut(
            banded["lang_czech_share"], LANGUAGE_BANDS, right=False,
            labels=LANGUAGE_LABELS).astype(object).fillna("no census row")
        czech = banded[banded["okres_language"] == LANGUAGE_LABELS[-1]]
        tables["settlements_by_land_and_language"] = _share_table(banded, ["land", "okres_language"])
        tables["settlements_czech_okresy_by_land_and_size"] = _share_table(czech, ["land", "size_class"])
        spread = _share_table(czech, ["land", "okres_id", "okres_1910_cs"])
        spread = spread[spread["settlements"] >= MIN_OKRES_SETTLEMENTS]
        tables["czech_okresy_spread_by_land"] = spread.groupby("land")["share_ensemble_pre1914"].describe(
            percentiles=[0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9]).round(3).reset_index()
    tables["scope_note"] = pd.DataFrame({
        "what": ["1910 settlements in the denominator (whole country: all; a sample: those "
                 "whose latest okres is a sample okres)",
                 "sample okres on the timeline but not its latest okres (left out)",
                 "sample places tied to a settlement outside that denominator",
                 "sample places whose page is not cached"],
        "n": [n_scope,
              int((S["in_1910"] & ~in_scope
                   & S["okres_tokens"].map(lambda t: bool(set(t) & set(okresy)))).sum()),
              outside_scope, missing_pages]})

    # ── how the database documents a place, by okres ────────────────────────
    paged = sample[sample["page_cached"]]
    tables["documentation_by_okres"] = _documentation_table(paged, "okres")
    tables["documentation_by_land"] = _documentation_table(paged, "land")

    period = pd.Series([first_record_period(y, p) for y, p in
                        zip(paged["first_record_year"], paged["first_record_precision"])],
                       index=paged.index).rename("period")
    for name, by in (("first_record_distribution", "okres"),
                     ("first_record_distribution_by_land", "land")):
        dist = pd.crosstab(period, paged[by].fillna("(no 1910 settlement)")).reindex(
            PERIOD_ORDER, fill_value=0)
        dist["all"] = dist.sum(axis=1)
        tables[name] = dist
    # heaping: a year that many places share is a source being read, not theatre beginning
    exact = paged[paged["first_record_precision"].eq("year")]
    tables["first_record_heaping"] = (
        exact.groupby("okres")["first_record_year"]
        .apply(lambda s: ", ".join(f"{int(y)}×{n}" for y, n in s.value_counts().head(6).items()))
        .rename("commonest first-report years (year×places)").reset_index())
    tables["first_record_precision"] = (paged.groupby(["first_record_precision",
                                                       "first_record_qualified"]).size()
                                        .rename("places").reset_index())

    counts, unclassified = association_counts(
        ensembles[ensembles["geo_id"].isin(sample["geo_id"])], cutoff)
    tables["associations_pre1914"] = counts
    tables["unclassified_names"] = unclassified.head(25).rename("ensembles").reset_index()
    tables["ensemble_year_precision"] = (ensembles.groupby(
        ["year_from_precision", "year_to_precision", "open_ended"]).size()
        .rename("ensembles").reset_index())

    # ── the whole country, from step A alone ────────────────────────────────
    tables.update(country_tables(places, S))
    return tables


def country_tables(places: pd.DataFrame, settlement_frame_: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """From step A alone: which 1910 communes have *any* entry in the database.

    Presence only — the map XML has no dates.  The denominator is the 1910 communes
    (``status_1910 == "obec"``) of ``settlements_1910``; each is assigned to a present-day
    kraj through the latest okres on its timeline that the database knows.
    """
    S = settlement_frame_
    join = join_places_to_settlements(places, S)
    matched = join.dropna(subset=["settlement_row"])
    okres_kraj = (places.dropna(subset=["okres", "kraj"]).groupby("okres")["kraj"]
                  .agg(lambda s: s.mode().iloc[0]).to_dict())
    # the database files Prague under its numbered districts; the lexikon under "Praha"
    prague = next((k for k in okres_kraj.values() if k.startswith("Praha")), None)
    if prague:
        okres_kraj.setdefault("Praha", prague)

    def kraj_of(tokens: list[str]):
        for okres in reversed(tokens):
            if okres in okres_kraj:
                return okres_kraj[okres]
        return None

    communes = S[S["in_1910"] & S["status_1910"].eq("obec")].copy()
    communes["kraj"] = communes["okres_tokens"].map(kraj_of)
    communes["in_database"] = communes["settlement_row"].isin(matched["settlement_row"])

    def share(by: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        table = communes.groupby(by, dropna=False).agg(
            communes_1910=("settlement_row", "size"),
            in_database=("in_database", "sum")).reset_index()
        table["share"] = (table["in_database"] / table["communes_1910"]).round(3)
        return table

    by_kraj = share("kraj").merge(
        places.groupby("kraj").agg(
            database_places=("geo_id", "size"),
            database_obce=("type", lambda s: int((s == "Obec").sum()))).reset_index(),
        on="kraj", how="outer", validate="1:1")
    return {
        "country_join": (join["match_method"].value_counts().rename("places").reset_index()),
        "country_communes_by_kraj": by_kraj.sort_values("share", ascending=False),
        "country_communes_by_land": share("land"),
        "country_places_by_type": places.groupby("type").agg(
            places=("geo_id", "size"),
            matched=("geo_id", lambda s: int(s.isin(matched["geo_id"]).sum()))).reset_index(),
    }


_REPORT_ORDER = [
    ("country_places_by_type", "WHOLE COUNTRY (step A only) — database places, and how many tie to a 1910 settlement"),

def coverage_report(tables: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> None:
    """Print every table of :func:`coverage_tables`, in reading order."""
    with pd.option_context("display.width", 220, "display.max_columns", 40,
                           "display.max_rows", 200, "display.max_colwidth", 60):
        for key, title in _REPORT_ORDER:
            if key in tables:
                print(f"\n── {title}\n{tables[key].to_string()}")
